title: Neon Weather Dashboard
description: A beautiful, neon-themed weather dashboard built using OpenWeather API. Features geolocation, dynamic background changes based on time, and a sleek glassmorphic UI.

title: Aura Task Manager
description: A minimalist drag-and-drop task management tool inspired by Kanban boards. Built with React and framer-motion for smooth, fluid animations across the board.

title: PyData Analyzer
description: A fast script that parses large CSV files and generates interactive data visualizations using pandas and matplotlib. Perfect for quick data insights.
